explication: Elasticsearch is a distributed search, analytics, and data platform. The README’s principal workflow is sending documents through REST APIs, indexing them into an index or data stream, then searching them near real time. The graph also captures ingest-pipeline management and simulation, plus representative search and data-platform capabilities. Source excerpts are limited, so most internal runtime connections are left out; documented README relationships are cited, and the ingest simulation link is supported by the source index.
